issues.location: RES-15 (RR-17), Field, line 518 ("This is the one RR that changes an answer.")
issues.problem: No record makes this claim, and the doc contradicts it twice. In RES-13 (RR-24), visited first answers `ok(20 B)` ×11 and swept first answers `shutDown` ×11 ("Callers that wait then get `shutDown` rather than the asset"), so that answer does change with the order.
